Broke In O-Town: Cheap Things To Do In Orlando
Listen to audio version of this article

0:00 / 6:01
Instaread

Let’s be real for a second: Orlando will happily let you spend $20 on a craft cocktail and act like that’s normal. Personally? I can’t afford to do that all the time! Broke In O-Town is my new monthly series where I’m hunting down “cheap things to do in Orlando”! The actual—real deals so you can eat, drink, and play, without blinking at the bill!

Sound impossible in this city? Stick with me.

Cheap Things To Do In Orlando: Vol. 1

First up is the spot that actually kicked this whole series off….

The Anchor: Primrose Lanes (Milk District)

I’ve said it before and I’ll say it again — Primrose Lanes is one of my absolute favorite reasons to love the Milk District. It’s not just a gorgeous, retro-chic bowling alley; it’s basically a budget playground disguised as a boutique sports bar. And the food’s legit!!

In fact, they have 2 gorgeous bars, delicious food/cocktails, arcade, karaoke, roller rink, and historic bowling lanes. Did I mention the vibe? It’s a vibe on a vibe!

  • $10 bowling, Sunday and Monday. To be clear, $10 per hour per person. Plus $3 shoe rental.
  • All-day happy hour on Monday, plus a standard Mon-Fri 3–6 PM happy hour featuring $5 off cocktails, wine, and liquor.
  • 2-for-$20 martinis, every single day. Split it with a friend (or drink both, no judgment here) and you’re in for ten bucks.

Local Tip: Monday is secretly the absolute best day to go. You get the $10 bowling and Happy Hour!

Where: 400 N Primrose Dr, Orlando, FL 32803

The Pairing: Beefy King (Milk District)

Since you’re already in the neighborhood, head over to Beefy King. This is a true Milk District institution that has been slinging roast beef since 1968. That’s nearly 60 years!! You don’t stick around that long without a reason.

Prices still start around $4.50, which in 2026 feels like a complete formatting typo. Grab a classic roast beef sandwich, load up on some tater tots, and thank me later.

Where: 424 N Bumby Ave, Orlando, FL 32803 (Closed on Sunday. Hours M-F 10:00-5:30 Sat. 11:00-3:00)

Related: Looking for more iconic bites? Here is my round-up of the Most Nostalgic Orlando Restaurants You Have to Visit.

The Happy Hour Heroes (Downtown)

Downtown Orlando is stacked with weekday happy hours that don’t get nearly enough love:

Acropolis Greek Taverna

From 3–7 PM, Monday through Friday, they do $2 off all bar drinks and 50% off appetizers. It is the perfect spot to grab a giant gyro and a cold drink without denting your wallet.

Bonus Local Tip: They offer 2 hours of free validated parking in their garage (just scan the QR code from your server on the way out), which solves the absolute worst part of going downtown!

  • Where: 390 N Orange Ave, Suite 110, Orlando, FL 32801

Tacos My Guey

They run a Taco Tuesday special—Chips/salsa, 3 tacos, and a drink for $10.99! They also have $2.99 beers and a killer $3.99 margarita specials every single day from 3–6 PM. (Plus, they bring it back from 10 PM to midnight for the late-night crowd!)

  • Where: 131 N Orange Ave, Unit 103, Orlando, FL 32801 (they have several other locations FYI, click to see where)

The Winter Park Move: Garp & Fuss

Winter Park doesn’t always feel like a “budget-friendly” neighborhood, but Garp & Fuss keeps it incredibly real. Tucked away in a gorgeous, brick-walled space with a stunning glass-roofed solarium, they run a stellar happy hour Tuesday through Friday from 4–7 PM. We’re talking $5 select beers and wines, $6 Old Fashioneds, $7 cocktails of the day, and discounted appetizer specials. It is absolute proof you don’t need Park Avenue prices to have a fabulous Park Avenue evening.

Where: 348 N Park Ave, Winter Park, FL 32789

The Taco Fix: Tacos My Guey

They run a Taco Tuesday special—Chips/salsa, 3 tacos, and a drink for $10.99! They also have $2.99 beers and a killer $3.99 margarita specials every single day from 3–6 PM. (Plus, they bring it back from 10 PM to midnight for the late-night crowd!)

Where: 131 N Orange Ave, Unit 103, Orlando, FL 32801 (they have several other locations FYI, click to see where)

Related: If you love tacos as much as I do, don’t miss my master list of the Best Tacos in Orlando.

Quick-Reference: This Month’s Cheapest Nights Out

Planning Your Own “Broke In O-Town” Night

If you want a full night out without the full-price damage, here are two perfect game plans:

  • The Milk District Route: Hit Primrose Lanes for a few frames of $10 bowling and a round of those 2-for-$20 martinis. Once you’re done, head over to Beefy King for a quick, cheap, and legendary early dinner.
  • The Downtown Crawl: Start at Acropolis Greek Taverna for early afternoon happy hour drinks, half-off apps, and free parking, then wander over to Tacos My Guey for a late-night $2.99 beer-margarita cap.

This is only Vol. 1, and I already have a massive running list going for next month. If you have a neighborhood deal I absolutely need to know about — a secret happy hour, a $5 special, or an under-the-radar cheap eat — drop it in the comments or send me a DM. I want to feature it!

Which one of these deals are you trying first? Let me know below!
